title: YLLZI 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station — Qi, USB-C
short_description: Wireless 3-in-1 charging station by YLLZI in black with a USB-C connection. According to Amazon, compatible with iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods (with wireless charging case).
long_description: The YLLZI 3-in-1 charging station is a wireless (Qi) charging station in black with a USB-C connection. According to the Amazon listing it has a power rating of 20 W and is compatible with many iPhone models, the Apple Watch and AirPods with a wireless charging case. The charging station, a user manual and a USB-C power adapter are included. Phone, watch and earbuds are not included. Please check on the Amazon product page whether your device is compatible before buying.
buying_angle: Useful on a desk or bedside table when several compatible devices should be charged on one wireless charging station.
